title: Swedish government offices to ban ChatGPT and Claude
script:
Sweden just banned ChatGPT and Claude from government offices.
The Government Offices of Sweden implemented this rule to secure internal information.
This restriction follows a broader shift across national agencies regarding digital security.
The Swedish Tax Agency already enforced a similar ban on these generative tools.
Officials now require employees to use internal, approved software for sensitive tasks.
The National Government Service Centre also joined these specific usage restrictions.
Would you trust a public official using AI to draft internal reports?
